tagline: Free Mail Merge for 2,000+ Avery, Zweckform & Other Templates
shortDescription: The lightweight, privacy-first Google Docs™ add-on to merge spreadsheets into perfect printable labels and envelopes. Zero invasive permissions, zero external tracking, and 100% free.

features.title: 2,000+ Pre-Calibrated Templates
features.description: Ready-to-print formats from Avery®, Avery Zweckform®, Herma®, and other standard commercial envelopes. Address labels, shipping tags, name badges, round stickers, and file folder tabs.

features.title: Strictly No Invasive Permissions
features.description: We only request access to the current document and the specific spreadsheet you select via Google Drive Picker. We NEVER ask for broad drive-wide read/write permissions.

features.title: Zero Document Data Leaves Your Workspace
features.description: All merge calculations, tag substitutions, and document generation take place entirely within Google's native client environment. Your recipient lists and addresses are never transmitted to third-party servers.

features.title: 100% Free to Use Forever
features.description: No hidden paywalls, no monthly subscription fees, no watermark branding on your labels, and no daily quota limits. Enjoy unrestricted mail merge directly in Google Docs.

features.title: Docs Sub-Point Precision & Shave Logic
features.description: Engineered with proprietary error diffusion shave logic that compensates for Google Docs' 5pt minimum limits and printer grip tolerances, ensuring perfect millimeter print alignment.

features.title: Dual Design Modes & Gridline Controls
features.description: Design once and auto-mirror across all cells for standard mail merges, or toggle 'Design each label separately' for custom individual badges. Toggle gridlines anytime with one click.

steps.title: Install & Open in Google Docs
steps.description: Install from the Google Workspace Marketplace with 1 click. Inside any Google Doc, click Extensions > Label Merge > Open.
steps.tip: Works on both personal Gmail and Google Workspace organization accounts.

steps.title: Select from 2,000+ Templates
steps.description: Search by product number (e.g. 5160, L7160, S-11854) or filter by brand (Avery, Zweckform, Herma, Envelopes, Others).
steps.tip: The add-on auto-configures page margins, table columns, and cell padding down to 1/20th point.

steps.title: Connect Your Google Sheet
steps.description: Click 'Select a spreadsheet' to securely pick your address list using the native Google Drive picker. Choose your sheet tab and click any header chip to insert {{Column}} tags.
steps.tip: Add formatting, bold text, company logos, barcodes, or custom colors to your master label.

steps.title: Click 'Create labels' & Print
steps.description: Hit 'Create labels'. The add-on iterates through your spreadsheet rows and creates perfectly populated pages. Open the PDF export and print at 100% scale.
steps.tip: Remember to set your printer margins to 'None / 0' and scale to 'Actual Size (100%)' for perfect label registration.

faq.question: Is Label Merge really 100% free?
faq.answer: Yes! Label Merge is completely free to use. There are no paid tiers, no subscription prompts, no daily caps, and no watermark on your generated labels.

faq.question: Why does Label Merge not ask for full Google Drive access?
faq.answer: Most add-ons lazily request full drive access ('drive.readonly' or 'drive'). We specifically architected this add-on to request only 'documents.currentonly' and 'drive.file' through Google's native picker. We believe your private drive files should stay private.

faq.question: How do I ensure my labels print without shifting or misalignment?
faq.answer: In your print dialog: 1) Ensure paper size matches your template (Letter or A4). 2) Set Margins to 'None' or '0'. 3) Set Scale to exactly '100%' or 'Actual Size' (never 'Fit to Printable Area'). Our built-in Twips shave logic ensures Docs tables match standard die-cut tolerances.

faq.question: Can I merge images or logos onto each label?
faq.answer: Yes! You can insert your company logo, return address, clipart, or barcode image directly into the top-left template cell in Google Docs. When you click 'Create labels', your visual layout is cloned faithfully across every cell.

faq.question: What template brands are supported?
faq.answer: We host over 2,000 templates including Avery US & Canada, Avery Zweckform Europe & UK, Herma, other industrial labels, and commercial envelope sizes.

faq.question: Can I customize the settings on this website?
faq.answer: Yes! The entire website is driven by config.json. When hosted on GitHub Pages, you can edit /public/config.json in your repository to update logos, links, marketplace URLs, template lists, and text without touching code.
